objective: Translate the elimination closure at a gluing line into resolution on the not-all-equal (complement-closed 3-CNF) encoding. Prove that every elimination the closure makes at a gluing line is a sign-compatible elimination, i.e. two width-3 resolution steps, so that the closure's crossing knots are exactly the width-3 resolution consequences of the one-sided 3-variable implicates, derived in depth two by resolving only on gluing-line variables; then determine what new knots (creation) need: whether they are implied by one-sided 3-variable implicates and the least resolution width that derives them. Exhaustive over PENDANT-LINE A's local configurations, or the first counterexample.
status: Proved by TWO-ROUND-BRIDGE-20261106-001A-P001: the knot closure is width-3 resolution and creation is width 4. Two knots sharing two variables resolve at width 3 exactly when sign-compatible; at a gluing line the closure's crossing knots are exactly the width-3 resolution consequences of the one-sided implicates on at most three variables, each in depth one or two, resolving only on gluing-line variables along a linear chain from one far knot; every new knot is implied by the same implicates and needs width exactly 4 (depth 2). The rule's literal pairs step is usually not a resolution step (1,645,912 of 1,685,232 local instances), but a near-knot route is. Exhaustive over 348,376,032 local configurations and the local data of 52,308 crossing knots
title: The knot closure is width-3 resolution
